jp: 金毛九尾が体毛を変化させて作った金色の葉っぱ。特殊な妖気が込められており、爆発する。対になる銀色の葉っぱを揃えて祠に行くと森の守り神が出現する、という伝説が残っている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～
jp_grezzo: "金毛九尾が体毛を変化させて作った金色の葉っぱ。特殊な妖気が込められており、爆発する。対になる銀色の葉っぱを揃えて祠に行くと森の守り神が出現する、という伝説が残っている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～"
en: A golden leaf created by a golden-haired Nine Tail polymorphing its body hair. It contains a special Yokai energy and explodes. Legend has it that if one goes to the shrine with a pair of silver leaves, a guardian deity of the forest will appear. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A golden leaf created by a golden-haired Nine Tail polymorphing its body hair. It contains a special Yokai energy and explodes. Legend has it that if one goes to the shrine with a pair of silver leaves, a guardian deity of the forest will appear. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una foglia dorata che le Nove Code Dorate hanno creato trasformando il proprio pelo. Dentro ci sta chiusa un'aura sinistra fuori dal comune, ed esplode. Resta una leggenda: chi si presenta al sacello con la foglia d'argento che le fa il paio vede comparire il nume che veglia sul bosco. \n#~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: 「おぬしにハッパをかけてやろうぞ…ドカーン！」\n#～金毛九尾の言葉～
jp_grezzo: "「おぬしにハッパをかけてやろうぞ…ドカーン！」\n#～金毛九尾の言葉～"
en: Lemme give you a little nudge...boom!\n# ~words of Kyu-Bi~
en_grezzo: "Lemme give you a little nudge...boom!\n# ~words of Kyu-Bi~"
it: \"Adesso ti do io la carica... BUM!\"\n# ~Parole della Volpe a Nove Code dal Manto d'Oro~

jp: 謎の古めかしい紙。秘伝の魔術と特殊繊維が編み込まれており、投擲暗器として使える程度の強度を持つ。しかし真の能力は別にあり、魔法紙を操る古の魔術の習得者だけがそれを解放できるとされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～
jp_grezzo: "謎の古めかしい紙。秘伝の魔術と特殊繊維が編み込まれており、投擲暗器として使える程度の強度を持つ。しかし真の能力は別にあり、魔法紙を操る古の魔術の習得者だけがそれを解放できるとされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～"
en: Mysterious, antiquated paper. It is woven with hidden magic and special fibres, and is robust enough to be used as a throwing weapon. However, it is believed that its true ability lies elsewhere and that only those who have mastered the ancient magic of manipulating paper can unleash it.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Mysterious, antiquated paper. It is woven with hidden magic and special fibres, and is robust enough to be used as a throwing weapon. However, it is believed that its true ability lies elsewhere and that only those who have mastered the ancient magic of manipulating paper can unleash it.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una carta antica e misteriosa. Ci sono intessute dentro una magia segreta e fibre speciali, ed è tanto robusta da servire come arma nascosta da lancio. Ma la sua capacità vera è un'altra, e si dice che possa liberarla solo chi ha imparato l'antica magia che governa la carta magica.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t成分は普通のエビフライとほぼ変わりないのだが、エビフライ・エフェクトと呼ばれる現象を引き起こし、色々あって爆発する危険物。空中散布されると、ミサイルのように飛んでいったり地雷のように残ったりする。見た目に興味を持った子供が犠牲になりやすく、「悪魔の兵器」の別称でも知られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t成分は普通のエビフライとほぼ変わりないのだが、エビフライ・エフェクトと呼ばれる現象を引き起こし、色々あって爆発する危険物。空中散布されると、ミサイルのように飛んでいったり地雷のように残ったりする。見た目に興味を持った子供が犠牲になりやすく、「悪魔の兵器」の別称でも知られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: While its ingredients are almost the same as those of ordinary fried shrimp, it is a hazardous substance that causes a phenomenon known as the shell-shocking effect, which can cause an explosion for various reasons. When scattered in the air, it can fly away like a missile or remain behind like a land mine. Children who are interested in the appearance of the product tend to become victims, shrimply devilish. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "While its ingredients are almost the same as those of ordinary fried shrimp, it is a hazardous substance that causes a phenomenon known as the shell-shocking effect, which can cause an explosion for various reasons. When scattered in the air, it can fly away like a missile or remain behind like a land mine. Children who are interested in the appearance of the product tend to become victims, shrimply devilish. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Negli ingredienti non è quasi diverso da un gambero fritto normale, ma provoca il fenomeno detto effetto gambero fritto e, per un motivo o per l'altro, finisce con l'esplodere: è materiale pericoloso. Sparso in aria, o vola via come un missile o resta a terra come una mina. Cadono vittime soprattutto i bambini, incuriositi dall'aspetto, e per questo lo chiamano anche l'arma del diavolo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「エビフライ５本くらいぶつけんぞ」\n#～混乱する店員の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「エビフライ５本くらいぶつけんぞ」\n#～混乱する店員の言葉～\n"
en: \"Haha! a traveling merchant with some prawn money!! I'm gonna hit the shrimping ground running!\" \n# ~words of a eccentric bandit~
en_grezzo: "\"Haha! a traveling merchant with some prawn money!! I'm gonna hit the shrimping ground running!\" \n# ~words of a eccentric bandit~"
it: \"Guarda che te ne tiro addosso cinque, di gamberi fritti!\" \n# ~Parole di un Commesso Confuso~

jp: \t\t闇の犯罪組織で作られた炎弩。電磁誘導で矢弾を加速して撃ち出し、通電時の余剰熱を利用して発火させるらしい。構造が不完全であり、交差部がバチバチ光ったりする。その時はとても危険なので触らないように。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t闇の犯罪組織で作られた炎弩。電磁誘導で矢弾を加速して撃ち出し、通電時の余剰熱を利用して発火させるらしい。構造が不完全であり、交差部がバチバチ光ったりする。その時はとても危険なので触らないように。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A flame crossbow made by a shadowy criminal syndicate. It is said to accelerate and shoot out arrows by electromagnetic induction, and ignite them by using the excess heat generated. The structure is imperfect, and the crossed parts sometimes glow. In that case, it is very dangerous, so do not touch it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A flame crossbow made by a shadowy criminal syndicate. It is said to accelerate and shoot out arrows by electromagnetic induction, and ignite them by using the excess heat generated. The structure is imperfect, and the crossed parts sometimes glow. In that case, it is very dangerous, so do not touch it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una balestra di fuoco costruita da un'organizzazione criminale dell'ombra. Pare che acceleri e scagli i dardi per induzione elettromagnetica, e che li accenda col calore in più che la corrente lascia. La struttura non è perfetta, e ogni tanto il punto d'incrocio manda scintille: quando succede è pericolosissima, e non va toccata. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t今は亡き弩砲職人の、晩年の作品。狙撃仕様の軽量バリスタ。職人の全知識を注いだ結果、狙撃銃と同等の射程を実現。貫通力と取り回し面も向上している。弩砲コレクター垂涎の逸品。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t今は亡き弩砲職人の、晩年の作品。狙撃仕様の軽量バリスタ。職人の全知識を注いだ結果、狙撃銃と同等の射程を実現。貫通力と取り回し面も向上している。弩砲コレクター垂涎の逸品。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The late work of a now deceased crossbowman. A lightweight ballista with sharpshooter specifications. As a result of the craftsman's full knowledge, it has a range equivalent to that of a sniper rifle. Penetration and handling have also been improved. A coveted item for crossbow collectors. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The late work of a now deceased crossbowman. A lightweight ballista with sharpshooter specifications. As a result of the craftsman's full knowledge, it has a range equivalent to that of a sniper rifle. Penetration and handling have also been improved. A coveted item for crossbow collectors. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: L'opera degli ultimi anni di un artigiano di baliste che non c'è più. Una balista leggera, fatta per il tiro di precisione. L'artigiano ci ha versato dentro tutto il suo sapere, e ne è uscita una gittata pari a quella di un fucile di precisione. Migliorano anche la forza di penetrazione e il maneggio. Un pezzo da far venire l'acquolina a chi colleziona baliste. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tヨミトノカケラ。冥界との通路を塞いでいた大岩の破片。何度取り換えても亡者どもが粉砕してしまうため、管理担当者は大変困っているらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tヨミトノカケラ。冥界との通路を塞いでいた大岩の破片。何度取り換えても亡者どもが粉砕してしまうため、管理担当者は大変困っているらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Yomi-To Shards. A piece of a large rock that was blocking the gateway to the underworld. The management is apparently having a hard time replacing it because no matter how many times it is replaced, the deceased keep smashing it up. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Yomi-To Shards. A piece of a large rock that was blocking the gateway to the underworld. The management is apparently having a hard time replacing it because no matter how many times it is replaced, the deceased keep smashing it up. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una scheggia dello Yomi-To. È il frammento del masso che chiudeva il passaggio verso l'Oltretomba. Per quante volte lo si rimetta i morti lo riducono in pezzi, e pare che chi ne ha la cura sia in grande difficoltà. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t毒蛇まみれの洞窟最奥に眠っていた。顔面への毒攻撃をコンセプトとした連弩のようで、矢の先端に飛び散る毒液を塗って連射する。毒が眼に入ると、激しい痛みを感じる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t毒蛇まみれの洞窟最奥に眠っていた。顔面への毒攻撃をコンセプトとした連弩のようで、矢の先端に飛び散る毒液を塗って連射する。毒が眼に入ると、激しい痛みを感じる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It was lying at the innermost part of the cave covered with poisonous snakes. It seems to be a repeating crossbow based on the concept of a venom attack to the face. The tips of the arrows are coated with splashing venom and fired in rapid succession. When the poison enters the eye, it causes severe pain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It was lying at the innermost part of the cave covered with poisonous snakes. It seems to be a repeating crossbow based on the concept of a venom attack to the face. The tips of the arrows are coated with splashing venom and fired in rapid succession. When the poison enters the eye, it causes severe pain. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Dormiva in fondo a una grotta piena di serpenti velenosi. Pare un arco a ripetizione pensato per colpire il viso col veleno: la punta delle frecce si spalma di un veleno che schizza, e si tira colpo su colpo. Se il veleno entra negli occhi, il dolore è violento. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tクイックリング族に伝わるショートボウ。普通の弓よりずっと小さいが、クイックリングにとってはこれぐらいで丁度いいらしい。魔法でカバーしているので、小さいながらも威力はある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tクイックリング族に伝わるショートボウ。普通の弓よりずっと小さいが、クイックリングにとってはこれぐらいで丁度いいらしい。魔法でカバーしているので、小さいながらも威力はある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This is a short bow that has been handed down from generation to generation among the Quicklings. It is much smaller than an ordinary bow, but it is said that this is just right for the Quicklings. It is covered with magic, so although it is small, it is powerful. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This is a short bow that has been handed down from generation to generation among the Quicklings. It is much smaller than an ordinary bow, but it is said that this is just right for the Quicklings. It is covered with magic, so although it is small, it is powerful. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un arco corto che si tramanda fra i quickling. È molto più piccolo di un arco normale, ma pare che per un quickling questa misura sia quella giusta. Al resto rimedia la magia, e per quanto piccolo la forza ce l'ha. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tとっさの白兵戦も視野に入れた弓。弧の部分が二重構造になっており、外装に刀身と鍔を持つ。リムは内側に独立しているので、外装が鍔迫り合いでたわんでも矢を放てる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tとっさの白兵戦も視野に入れた弓。弧の部分が二重構造になっており、外装に刀身と鍔を持つ。リムは内側に独立しているので、外装が鍔迫り合いでたわんでも矢を放てる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This is a bow designed for close-quarter combat. The arc has a double structure, with the blade on the exterior. The rim is separate on the inside, so arrows can be released even if the exterior bends in a swordfight. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This is a bow designed for close-quarter combat. The arc has a double structure, with the blade on the exterior. The rim is separate on the inside, so arrows can be released even if the exterior bends in a swordfight. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un arco che tiene conto anche del corpo a corpo improvviso. La parte curva ha una doppia struttura, e di fuori porta una lama con la sua guardia. I flettenti restano dentro, staccati, così anche quando l'esterno si piega nell'incrociare le guardie la freccia parte lo stesso. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t先端部に着火用のバレルを設けた弩。発射時にボルトが燃え上がり、火矢となって飛んでいく。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t先端部に着火用のバレルを設けた弩。発射時にボルトが燃え上がり、火矢となって飛んでいく。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A crossbow with an ignition barrel at the tip. When fired, the bolt burns up and flies as a fire arrow. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A crossbow with an ignition barrel at the tip. When fired, the bolt burns up and flies as a fire arrow. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una balestra con in punta una canna che serve ad accendere. Al momento del tiro il dardo prende fuoco e vola via come freccia infuocata. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t一組の銃。片手で扱えるよう、反動を抑える工夫がされている。当たりっこないので複数の敵にそれぞれで同時発砲するのはオススメしない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一組の銃。片手で扱えるよう、反動を抑える工夫がされている。当たりっこないので複数の敵にそれぞれで同時発砲するのはオススメしない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A pair of guns. They are designed to suppress recoil so that they can be handled with one hand. It is not recommended to fire at multiple enemies at the same time. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A pair of guns. They are designed to suppress recoil so that they can be handled with one hand. It is not recommended to fire at multiple enemies at the same time. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un paio di pistole. Sono studiate per frenare il rinculo, così da tenerne una per mano. Sparare con tutt'e due insieme su nemici diversi non conviene: non si prende niente. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tはるか昔、虫相撲のためだけにサイボーグ化された甲虫。昔は養殖も盛んに行われていたが、今では捨てられて野生化した個体がひっそり生きている程度。投げれば猛獣すら吹き飛ばし、使い手とシンクロすれば謎の光線や爆風も出せる。喋りこそしないが自我を持っているので、名前をつけて可愛がってやろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tはるか昔、虫相撲のためだけにサイボーグ化された甲虫。昔は養殖も盛んに行われていたが、今では捨てられて野生化した個体がひっそり生きている程度。投げれば猛獣すら吹き飛ばし、使い手とシンクロすれば謎の光線や爆風も出せる。喋りこそしないが自我を持っているので、名前をつけて可愛がってやろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Long ago, these beetles were cyborgified for the sole purpose of insect wrestling. Due to being cultivated extensively in the past, these beetles are now only found in the wild, abandoned, and living in secret. When thrown, it can destroy even the most ferocious of beasts, and when synchronized with its wielder, it can produce mysterious beams of light and destruction. Although they do not speak, they have an ego, so you should name them and take good care of them. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Long ago, these beetles were cyborgified for the sole purpose of insect wrestling. Due to being cultivated extensively in the past, these beetles are now only found in the wild, abandoned, and living in secret. When thrown, it can destroy even the most ferocious of beasts, and when synchronized with its wielder, it can produce mysterious beams of light and destruction. Although they do not speak, they have an ego, so you should name them and take good care of them. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno scarabeo che tanto tempo fa fu reso cibernetico solo per farlo lottare con altri insetti. Un tempo se ne allevavano molti; oggi restano soltanto quelli abbandonati, inselvatichiti, che vivono nascosti. A lanciarlo spazza via perfino una belva, e se va all'unisono con chi lo usa scaglia raggi misteriosi e soffi di scoppio. Non parla, ma un io ce l'ha: dagli un nome e vogliagli bene. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t強い憎しみを乗せた矢を放つ骨弓。この世の全てに憎悪を抱くほどに虐げ尽くした獣を、惨たらしく殺しその骨を用いて作成される。射られる側からすれば憎悪をぶつけられていい迷惑。ほとんどが古代に作られた品だが、現代でもどこかの部族が密かに作り続けているらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t強い憎しみを乗せた矢を放つ骨弓。この世の全てに憎悪を抱くほどに虐げ尽くした獣を、惨たらしく殺しその骨を用いて作成される。射られる側からすれば憎悪をぶつけられていい迷惑。ほとんどが古代に作られた品だが、現代でもどこかの部族が密かに作り続けているらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A bone bow that shoots arrows carrying strong hatred. It is made from the bones of a brutally slaughtered beast that has been abused to the point of hatred for everything in the world. The person being shot will be inconvenienced by the hatred being unleashed on them. Most of bows were made in ancient times, but it is said that even today, some tribes continue to make them in secret. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A bone bow that shoots arrows carrying strong hatred. It is made from the bones of a brutally slaughtered beast that has been abused to the point of hatred for everything in the world. The person being shot will be inconvenienced by the hatred being unleashed on them. Most of bows were made in ancient times, but it is said that even today, some tribes continue to make them in secret. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un arco d'ossa che scaglia frecce cariche d'odio. Si ricava dalle ossa di una bestia torturata fino a farle odiare ogni cosa al mondo, e poi uccisa in modo atroce. Per chi si prende la freccia, ricevere addosso quell'odio è una bella seccatura. Quasi tutti vengono dall'antichità, ma pare che ancora oggi qualche tribù continui a farne di nascosto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tエウダーナの魔弓をベースに、イェルスの機械技術を組み込み強化した斬弓。白兵戦もこなせるほか、トリガーを引くとスタビライザーから電撃を放てる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエウダーナの魔弓をベースに、イェルスの機械技術を組み込み強化した斬弓。白兵戦もこなせるほか、トリガーを引くとスタビライザーから電撃を放てる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Enhanced from Eulderna magic bow, it is a slashing bow that incorporates the mechanical technology of the Yerles army. In addition to being able to engage in hand-to-hand combat, it can also release electric blasts from its stabilizers when you pull its strings. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Enhanced from Eulderna magic bow, it is a slashing bow that incorporates the mechanical technology of the Yerles army. In addition to being able to engage in hand-to-hand combat, it can also release electric blasts from its stabilizers when you pull its strings. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un arco a lame che parte da un arco magico di Eulderna e lo rinforza innestandoci la tecnica meccanica di Yerles. Regge anche il corpo a corpo, e a premere il grilletto dagli stabilizzatori parte una scarica elettrica. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t手裏剣の一種で、強力なエネルギーを纏っている。直撃すれば戦闘機の装甲も貫通するほどの切れ味。別にイオンでできているわけではないが、イオンビームによって加工されたためこう呼ばれる。エネルギー状態によって色は青や水色にも変化する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手裏剣の一種で、強力なエネルギーを纏っている。直撃すれば戦闘機の装甲も貫通するほどの切れ味。別にイオンでできているわけではないが、イオンビームによって加工されたためこう呼ばれる。エネルギー状態によって色は青や水色にも変化する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It is a type of shuriken that is coated with powerful energy. A direct hit is sharp enough to penetrate the armor of a fighter plane. It is not made of ions, but is so called because it is processed by ion beams. The color changes to blue or light blue depending on the energy state. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It is a type of shuriken that is coated with powerful energy. A direct hit is sharp enough to penetrate the armor of a fighter plane. It is not made of ions, but is so called because it is processed by ion beams. The color changes to blue or light blue depending on the energy state. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un tipo di shuriken, avvolto in un'energia potente. Se coglie in pieno taglia tanto da passare da parte a parte anche la corazza di un aereo da combattimento. Di ioni non è fatto affatto: lo chiamano così perché è stato lavorato con un fascio di ioni. Secondo lo stato dell'energia il colore vira all'azzurro o al celeste. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t特定の遺跡から発見される光子銃。地味に重い。なぜかカラスが装備していることがあるため、形式番号とあわせて「カラスワ」と呼ばれる。正式な名称等は不明。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定の遺跡から発見される光子銃。地味に重い。なぜかカラスが装備していることがあるため、形式番号とあわせて「カラスワ」と呼ばれる。正式な名称等は不明。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Photon guns found at archaeological sites. It is rather heavy. For some reason, crows are sometimes equipped with this gun, so it is called 'Karasawa' together with its model number. The official name is unknown. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Photon guns found at archaeological sites. It is rather heavy. For some reason, crows are sometimes equipped with this gun, so it is called 'Karasawa' together with its model number. The official name is unknown. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una pistola laser che si ritrova in certe rovine. È pesante più di quanto sembri. Chissà perché, capita che ce l'abbiano addosso i corvi, e per questo, mettendoci insieme la sigla, la chiamano karasuwa. Come si chiami davvero non si sa. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t大型クロスボウの一種。小型のものは担いだり背負ったりしてどうにか運ぶことが可能だが、本来は据え置きの砲台。一応、折り畳み式の支柱が下部についているが取り回しは悪い。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大型クロスボウの一種。小型のものは担いだり背負ったりしてどうにか運ぶことが可能だが、本来は据え置きの砲台。一応、折り畳み式の支柱が下部についているが取り回しは悪い。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A type of large crossbow. The smaller ones can be carried somehow by carrying or on the back, but they are essentially stationary turrets. It has a foldable prop at the bottom, but it is not easy to maneuver. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A type of large crossbow. The smaller ones can be carried somehow by carrying or on the back, but they are essentially stationary turrets. It has a foldable prop at the bottom, but it is not easy to maneuver. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un tipo di balestra di grande taglia. Le più piccole si riesce in qualche modo a portarle in spalla o a tracolla, ma di suo è un pezzo d'artiglieria da postazione fissa. Sotto ha dei sostegni pieghevoli, ma restare comoda da maneggiare non ci riesce. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t混戦の中、戦艦副砲の予備パーツを用いて機械の神が咄嗟に作り出した武器。神力の込められた一撃は混沌艦隊の船体を易々と貫き、衝撃波で眷属どもを霧状に消し飛ばしてしまったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t混戦の中、戦艦副砲の予備パーツを用いて機械の神が咄嗟に作り出した武器。神力の込められた一撃は混沌艦隊の船体を易々と貫き、衝撃波で眷属どもを霧状に消し飛ばしてしまったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: In the midst of a chaotic battle, the God of Machine created this weapon on the spur of the moment using spare parts from the sub-cannon of a battleship. It is said that the shot it fires, which was filled with divine power, easily penetrated the hull of the chaos fleet, and its shockwave obliterated all the chaos servants in the fleet. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "In the midst of a chaotic battle, the God of Machine created this weapon on the spur of the moment using spare parts from the sub-cannon of a battleship. It is said that the shot it fires, which was filled with divine power, easily penetrated the hull of the chaos fleet, and its shockwave obliterated all the chaos servants in the fleet. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma che il dio delle macchine mise insieme lì per lì, nel folto della mischia, coi pezzi di ricambio del cannone secondario di una corazzata. Si racconta che il colpo, carico di forza divina, passasse da parte a parte lo scafo della flotta del caos, e che l'onda d'urto riducesse in nebbia i suoi servitori. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t大きな岩の塊。こんなものをぶつけられたら痛いでは済まない。重いうえに形状が歪で投げにくいため、他の投擲武器以上に近距離でないと威力は発揮できないだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きな岩の塊。こんなものをぶつけられたら痛いでは済まない。重いうえに形状が歪で投げにくいため、他の投擲武器以上に近距離でないと威力は発揮できないだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A big chunk of rock. It is not enough to say that it hurts if you are hit by such a thing. Because it is heavy and its distorted shape makes it difficult to throw, it is more powerful than other throwing weapons only at close range. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A big chunk of rock. It is not enough to say that it hurts if you are hit by such a thing. Because it is heavy and its distorted shape makes it difficult to throw, it is more powerful than other throwing weapons only at close range. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un grosso blocco di roccia. Prendersene uno addosso non finisce con un semplice male. È pesante, e per giunta ha una forma storta che lo rende difficile da tirare: più ancora delle altre armi da lancio, la sua forza si vede solo da vicino. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t巻き上げ機ではなくハンドルで弦を起こすクロスボウ。弾倉がついており装填速度は増しているが、一発ごとの威力と精度は格段に劣る。鎧を貫く力はなく、ボルトに塗った毒で威力を補う。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巻き上げ機ではなくハンドルで弦を起こすクロスボウ。弾倉がついており装填速度は増しているが、一発ごとの威力と精度は格段に劣る。鎧を貫く力はなく、ボルトに塗った毒で威力を補う。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This crossbow uses a handle, not a winder, to raise the string. It is equipped with a magazine, which increases the loading speed, but the power and accuracy of each shot are much less powerful.It does not have the power to pierce armor, and its power is compensated for by poison applied to the bolt. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This crossbow uses a handle, not a winder, to raise the string. It is equipped with a magazine, which increases the loading speed, but the power and accuracy of each shot are much less powerful.It does not have the power to pierce armor, and its power is compensated for by poison applied to the bolt. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una balestra che tende la corda con una manovella invece che con l'argano. Ha un caricatore, quindi si ricarica più in fretta, ma colpo per colpo forza e precisione calano di parecchio. Bucare un'armatura non può: alla forza che le manca supplisce col veleno spalmato sui dardi. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tグリフォンから生み出された二つで一つの銃で、連射性能が非常に高い。握りやすい大型のグリップが特徴。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tグリフォンから生み出された二つで一つの銃で、連射性能が非常に高い。握りやすい大型のグリップが特徴。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This two-in-one gun, created from a griffon, has extremely high rapid-firing performance. It features a large, easy-to-hold grip. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This two-in-one gun, created from a griffon, has extremely high rapid-firing performance. It features a large, easy-to-hold grip. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Due pistole che fanno una cosa sola, nate da un grifone, e che sparano di fila a gran velocità. Le distingue l'impugnatura grande, comoda da tenere. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t遺跡から発見された、フルオート射撃可能・専用小型榴弾発射可能な珍しいショットガンを改修したもの。発見者は量産化を軍に提案したが、重く、嵩張り、過剰火力であるため見向きもされなかった。その後は、ストックと銃身を切り詰める等、開き直った発見者があえて近接戦特化で改修。破壊力と制圧力は名前通りトリプルＡだが、代償に銃として大事なものが色々と抜け落ちている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t遺跡から発見された、フルオート射撃可能・専用小型榴弾発射可能な珍しいショットガンを改修したもの。発見者は量産化を軍に提案したが、重く、嵩張り、過剰火力であるため見向きもされなかった。その後は、ストックと銃身を切り詰める等、開き直った発見者があえて近接戦特化で改修。破壊力と制圧力は名前通りトリプルＡだが、代償に銃として大事なものが色々と抜け落ちている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A modified version of a rare shotgun found at the ruins, capable of full-auto fire and firing a dedicated small grenade. The discoverer proposed mass production to the military, but it was not considered because it was heavy, bulky, and had excessive firepower. Afterwards, the discoverer dared to modify it to specialize in close quarters combat by trimming the stock and barrel, etc. The destructive and suppressive power is triple-A as the name suggests, but at the cost of missing various important qualities for a gun. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A modified version of a rare shotgun found at the ruins, capable of full-auto fire and firing a dedicated small grenade. The discoverer proposed mass production to the military, but it was not considered because it was heavy, bulky, and had excessive firepower. Afterwards, the discoverer dared to modify it to specialize in close quarters combat by trimming the stock and barrel, etc. The destructive and suppressive power is triple-A as the name suggests, but at the cost of missing various important qualities for a gun. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il rifacimento di un raro fucile a pompa trovato fra le rovine, capace di tiro tutto automatico e di lanciare piccole granate apposite. Chi lo trovò propose all'esercito di produrlo in serie, ma pesante, ingombrante e con troppa potenza di fuoco com'era, nessuno lo degnò di uno sguardo. Allora, presala di petto, lo rifece apposta per il combattimento ravvicinato, accorciando calcio e canna. Per forza distruttiva e capacità di tenere a bada il nemico è tripla A come dice il nome, ma in cambio ha perso per strada parecchie cose che a un fucile servono. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「なんじゃこの改修プランは！？気が狂っとる…」\n#～伝説の職人『ガロク』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「なんじゃこの改修プランは！？気が狂っとる…」\n#～伝説の職人『ガロク』の言葉～\n"
en: \"What's with this renovation plan? This is madness...\" \n# ~words of <Garok> the Legendary Smith~
en_grezzo: "\"What's with this renovation plan? This is madness...\" \n# ~words of <Garok> the Legendary Smith~"
it: \"Ma che roba è questo piano di rifacimento?! Qui è da matti...\" \n# ~Parole di <Garok> il fabbro leggendario~

jp: \t\tカード型の暗器。ふちの部分が鋭い刃になっており、人間の首くらいなら簡単に切断できる。投擲時の安定性を高めるために少し重く作られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカード型の暗器。ふちの部分が鋭い刃になっており、人間の首くらいなら簡単に切断できる。投擲時の安定性を高めるために少し重く作られている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Card-shaped hidden-weapons. The edge has a sharp blade that can easily cut off a human head. It is made a little heavier to enhance stability when throwing. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Card-shaped hidden-weapons. The edge has a sharp blade that can easily cut off a human head. It is made a little heavier to enhance stability when throwing. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma nascosta a forma di carta da gioco. Il bordo è una lama affilata, e un collo umano lo taglia senza fatica. È fatta un po' pesante per restare stabile quando la si lancia. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t風の女神が作り出し、かつて愛用していた大弓。放つ光を七変化させるその様子は、まるで移り気で気まぐれな女心のよう。派手すぎるのに飽きたという理由で手放された。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t風の女神が作り出し、かつて愛用していた大弓。放つ光を七変化させるその様子は、まるで移り気で気まぐれな女心のよう。派手すぎるのに飽きたという理由で手放された。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The great bow created by the goddess of winds and once used by her. The light that it emits changes seven times, just like a woman's mind, which is changeable and fickle. She gave it up because she was tired of being too flashy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The great bow created by the goddess of winds and once used by her. The light that it emits changes seven times, just like a woman's mind, which is changeable and fickle. She gave it up because she was tired of being too flashy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il grande arco che la dea del vento creò e portò a lungo con sé. La luce che scaglia cambia sette volte, come un cuore di donna volubile e capriccioso. Se ne è disfatta perché si era stancata di quanto fosse vistoso. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tラピッドボウガンの一種。根本からクロスボウの構造を見直して設計された逸品。連射・速射性能に優れる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tラピッドボウガンの一種。根本からクロスボウの構造を見直して設計された逸品。連射・速射性能に優れる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A type of rapid bowgun. It is a gem designed by fundamentally reviewing the structure of crossbow. It excels in rapid and continuous fire performance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A type of rapid bowgun. It is a gem designed by fundamentally reviewing the structure of crossbow. It excels in rapid and continuous fire performance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un tipo di balestra rapida. Un pezzo pregiato, progettato ripensando da capo la struttura della balestra. Eccelle nel tiro veloce e di fila. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t最高威力を誇る強力な手榴弾。それ故、爆風に巻き込まれないよう細心の注意を払う必要がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t最高威力を誇る強力な手榴弾。それ故、爆風に巻き込まれないよう細心の注意を払う必要がある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Grenade with the highest-spec firepower. Therefore, extreme care must be taken to avoid being caught in the blast. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Grenade with the highest-spec firepower. Therefore, extreme care must be taken to avoid being caught in the blast. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una granata potente, che vanta la forza più alta di tutte. Proprio per questo bisogna badare con la massima attenzione a non restare presi nello scoppio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t携行性と隠密性を犠牲にして威力を追求した手裏剣。その大きさはもはや暗器でないが、防御に使えるという長所も。刀身にはレアメタルが使われており、硬い物も切り裂く。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t携行性と隠密性を犠牲にして威力を追求した手裏剣。その大きさはもはや暗器でないが、防御に使えるという長所も。刀身にはレアメタルが使われており、硬い物も切り裂く。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A shuriken designed for power at the expense of portability and concealment. Its size makes it no longer a hidden-weapon, but it has the advantage that it can be used for defense. The blade is made of rare metal and can cut through hard objects. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A shuriken designed for power at the expense of portability and concealment. Its size makes it no longer a hidden-weapon, but it has the advantage that it can be used for defense. The blade is made of rare metal and can cut through hard objects. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno shuriken che ha cercato la forza sacrificando il poco ingombro e la segretezza. Grande com'è non è più un'arma nascosta, ma ha il pregio di servire anche a parare. La lama è di metallo raro, e taglia anche le cose dure. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t悪夢を断つ短剣。切れ味は大したことないが投げると遠くまでまっすぐ飛ぶ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t悪夢を断つ短剣。切れ味は大したことないが投げると遠くまでまっすぐ飛ぶ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Dagger that sever nightmares. It is not very sharp, but when thrown, it flies for a long distance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Dagger that sever nightmares. It is not very sharp, but when thrown, it flies for a long distance. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un pugnale che recide gli incubi. Non taglia granché, ma a lanciarlo vola lontano e dritto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大な石のお金。古代文明において流通していた現物であり、非常に貴重。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもない魅力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な石のお金。古代文明において流通していた現物であり、非常に貴重。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもない魅力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Huge stone money. It was circulated in ancient civilizations and is extremely valuable. It is so heavy that it cannot be handled by a human being, but when a person who knows how to use it appears, this weapon will bestow upon the user a tremendous charm. And a little whimsy.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Huge stone money. It was circulated in ancient civilizations and is extremely valuable. It is so heavy that it cannot be handled by a human being, but when a person who knows how to use it appears, this weapon will bestow upon the user a tremendous charm. And a little whimsy.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una moneta di pietra gigantesca. È il pezzo vero che circolava nella civiltà antica, ed è preziosissima. Pesa troppo perché un uomo la maneggi, ma quando comparirà qualcuno capace di usarla, quest'arma gli donerà un carisma smisurato. E insieme un pizzico di capriccio.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t狙撃に特化した銃器。遠距離からの射撃に適する。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t狙撃に特化した銃器。遠距離からの射撃に適する。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Firearm specialized for sniping. Suitable for shooting from a long distance. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Firearm specialized for sniping. Suitable for shooting from a long distance. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'arma da fuoco fatta apposta per il tiro di precisione. Adatta a sparare da lontano. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t凄腕の狙撃手の異名を冠した狙撃銃。狙撃用のスコープがついておらず、素人が目標に当てるのはとても難しい。また、銃身が少し短く重いものとなっている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t凄腕の狙撃手の異名を冠した狙撃銃。狙撃用のスコープがついておらず、素人が目標に当てるのはとても難しい。また、銃身が少し短く重いものとなっている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Sniper rifle, nicknamed the \"white death\". It does not have a sniper's scope, making it very difficult for an amateur to hit a target. Also, the barrel is a little short and heavy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Sniper rifle, nicknamed the \"white death\". It does not have a sniper's scope, making it very difficult for an amateur to hit a target. Also, the barrel is a little short and heavy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un fucile di precisione che porta il soprannome di un tiratore formidabile. Non ha il cannocchiale da tiro, e per un profano prendere il bersaglio è difficilissimo. La canna, poi, è un po' corta e pesante. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大なクロスボウ。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に飛びぬけた器用さを授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大なクロスボウ。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に飛びぬけた器用さを授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Giant crossbow. It is too heavy for a single person to handle, but when someone finds a way to use it, this weapon will give the user extraordinary dexterity. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Giant crossbow. It is too heavy for a single person to handle, but when someone finds a way to use it, this weapon will give the user extraordinary dexterity. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una balestra gigantesca. Pesa troppo perché un uomo la maneggi, ma quando comparirà qualcuno capace di usarla, quest'arma gli donerà una destrezza fuori dal comune. E insieme un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大なグレネードグラビティガン。グラビティガンの不安定さを補うため、グレネードランチャーが装着されている。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に超感覚を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大なグレネードグラビティガン。グラビティガンの不安定さを補うため、グレネードランチャーが装着されている。人では扱えない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に超感覚を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Huge grenade gravity gun. To compensate for the instability of the gravity gun, a grenade launcher is attached. It is too heavy for one person to handle, but when the right person comes along, this weapon will give the user extraordinary perception. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Huge grenade gravity gun. To compensate for the instability of the gravity gun, a grenade launcher is attached. It is too heavy for one person to handle, but when the right person comes along, this weapon will give the user extraordinary perception. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un enorme cannone a gravità con le granate. Per rimediare all'instabilità del cannone a gravità gli hanno montato sopra un lanciagranate. Pesa troppo perché un uomo lo maneggi, ma quando comparirà qualcuno capace di usarlo, quest'arma gli donerà una percezione fuori dall'umano. E insieme un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t二つで一つの銃。かつては双子が一つずつ使っていたという。兄が戦死した後、形見として銃は弟に引き継がれた。弟はその生涯をかけて二丁拳銃術の基礎を編み出したとされる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t二つで一つの銃。かつては双子が一つずつ使っていたという。兄が戦死した後、形見として銃は弟に引き継がれた。弟はその生涯をかけて二丁拳銃術の基礎を編み出したとされる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Two guns in one. It is said that a pair of twins used to use one gun each. After the older brother was killed in battle, the gun was passed down to the younger brother as a memento. The younger brother spent his life developing the fundamentals of the two-gun combat technique. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Two guns in one. It is said that a pair of twins used to use one gun each. After the older brother was killed in battle, the gun was passed down to the younger brother as a memento. The younger brother spent his life developing the fundamentals of the two-gun combat technique. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Due pistole che fanno una cosa sola. Si racconta che un tempo le usassero due gemelli, una per uno. Quando il maggiore cadde in battaglia, la sua pistola passò al minore come ricordo. E si dice che il minore abbia speso la vita intera a mettere a punto le basi dell'arte delle due pistole. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t気の遠くなるような大昔に、ある島国で使われていた貨幣。後世の文献によると、当時のガードの中にはこれを投げて戦うものがいたらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t気の遠くなるような大昔に、ある島国で使われていた貨幣。後世の文献によると、当時のガードの中にはこれを投げて戦うものがいたらしい。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A coin that was used in an island nation a long, long time ago. According to later documents, some of the guards of the time used to fight by throwing it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A coin that was used in an island nation a long, long time ago. According to later documents, some of the guards of the time used to fight by throwing it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una moneta che si usava in un paese d'isole tanto tempo fa da far girare la testa. Stando a testi più recenti, pare che fra le guardie di allora ci fosse chi combatteva lanciandola. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t複数の銃身を回転・発砲させることで発射時の摩擦熱を緩和し、より連射性能を高めることに成功した機関銃の一種。だが発射時の反動および振動を抑えるため意図的に少し連射速度が下げられている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複数の銃身を回転・発砲させることで発射時の摩擦熱を緩和し、より連射性能を高めることに成功した機関銃の一種。だが発射時の反動および振動を抑えるため意図的に少し連射速度が下げられている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A type of machine gun in which multiple barrels are rotated and fired to reduce frictional heat during firing and to increase rapid-fire performance. However, the rate of fire is intentionally slightly reduced to suppress the recoil and vibration when firing. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A type of machine gun in which multiple barrels are rotated and fired to reduce frictional heat during firing and to increase rapid-fire performance. However, the rate of fire is intentionally slightly reduced to suppress the recoil and vibration when firing. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un tipo di mitragliatrice che, facendo ruotare e sparare più canne insieme, è riuscita a smorzare il calore d'attrito del tiro e a spingere più in alto la rapidità di fuoco. Ma per frenare rinculo e vibrazioni la cadenza è stata abbassata un poco di proposito. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t生物の骨を削り出したものを基礎に、他の素材を重ね合わせることで柔軟さと強靭さを兼ね合わせた短弓。引き絞る際に余計な力がかからないように加工された優れた逸品だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生物の骨を削り出したものを基礎に、他の素材を重ね合わせることで柔軟さと強靭さを兼ね合わせた短弓。引き絞る際に余計な力がかからないように加工された優れた逸品だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This short bow combines flexibility and toughness by layering other materials on a foundation of carved biological bones. It is an excellent product that has been processed so that no unnecessary force is applied when drawing it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This short bow combines flexibility and toughness by layering other materials on a foundation of carved biological bones. It is an excellent product that has been processed so that no unnecessary force is applied when drawing it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un arco corto che mette insieme flessibilità e tenacia: alla base ci sono ossa d'animale intagliate, e sopra si sovrappongono altri materiali. Un pezzo pregiato, lavorato in modo che nel tenderlo non si sprechi forza. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t弾を込める作業を機械化することに成功した拳銃を改良したもの。悠久の時を経、残念ながら改良元は全て失われてしまったが、この銃だけは未だ健在である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t弾を込める作業を機械化することに成功した拳銃を改良したもの。悠久の時を経、残念ながら改良元は全て失われてしまったが、この銃だけは未だ健在である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: An improved version of the pistol that succeeded in mechanizing the work of loading the bullets. Unfortunately, all of the original improvements have been lost over the ages, but this gun is still alive and well. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "An improved version of the pistol that succeeded in mechanizing the work of loading the bullets. Unfortunately, all of the original improvements have been lost over the ages, but this gun is still alive and well. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il perfezionamento di una pistola che era riuscita a meccanizzare il lavoro di caricare i colpi. Nel lunghissimo tempo passato da allora, purtroppo, gli esemplari da cui viene sono andati tutti perduti: solo questa è ancora in forma. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t楽器とは名ばかりの投擲武器。巨大な金塊と見紛うべきそれは、かつて幾多の演奏者を屠ってきたのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t楽器とは名ばかりの投擲武器。巨大な金塊と見紛うべきそれは、かつて幾多の演奏者を屠ってきたのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Thrown weapon in the name of a musical instrument. It is said to have slaughtered many performers in the past. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Thrown weapon in the name of a musical instrument. It is said to have slaughtered many performers in the past. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma da lancio che di strumento musicale ha solo il nome. Quella cosa, che si scambierebbe per un enorme lingotto d'oro, si dice abbia macellato in passato un gran numero di musicisti. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t前面に小さいリボンをあしらった可愛らしい清楚な布切れ。往々にして本人ではなく他の誰かが所持しているが、そのことについて気付いていないのはシーナ本人だけであるという。\n#～情報屋ウィーゼムの調べた情報～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t前面に小さいリボンをあしらった可愛らしい清楚な布切れ。往々にして本人ではなく他の誰かが所持しているが、そのことについて気付いていないのはシーナ本人だけであるという。\n#～情報屋ウィーゼムの調べた情報～\n"
en: A lovely, neat piece of fabric with a cute little ribbon on the front. Often it is in the possession of someone else, but not the owner, and the only one who is unaware of this is Shena herself. \n# ~Intel of the Informant Wiesem~
en_grezzo: "A lovely, neat piece of fabric with a cute little ribbon on the front. Often it is in the possession of someone else, but not the owner, and the only one who is unaware of this is Shena herself. \n# ~Intel of the Informant Wiesem~"
it: Un pezzo di stoffa graziosa e per bene, con un nastrino sul davanti. Il più delle volte non ce l'ha lei, ma qualcun altro, e pare che l'unica a non essersene accorta sia proprio Shena. \n# ~Le Notizie Raccolte da <Wiesem> l'informatore~

jp: \t\t「炭鉱街を訪れた際、私は恋に落ちた。しかし話しかける勇気はなく、代わりに去る高名な盗賊に頼んでこれを手に入れたのさ。これで私と彼女はいつでも一緒。どうだ、うらやましいだろう！」\n#～貴族のラスター、最後の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「炭鉱街を訪れた際、私は恋に落ちた。しかし話しかける勇気はなく、代わりに去る高名な盗賊に頼んでこれを手に入れたのさ。これで私と彼女はいつでも一緒。どうだ、うらやましいだろう！」\n#～貴族のラスター、最後の言葉～\n"
en: \"I was minding my business in the mining town of Vernis, and BAM, I fell in love! But I didn't dare to spoke to her, so instead I asked a thief and stole this from her. And wow, love was much softer than what I had imagined! She and I will always be together.\" \n# ~last words, of Luster the noble~
en_grezzo: "\"I was minding my business in the mining town of Vernis, and BAM, I fell in love! But I didn't dare to spoke to her, so instead I asked a thief and stole this from her. And wow, love was much softer than what I had imagined! She and I will always be together.\" \n# ~last words, of Luster the noble~"
it: \"Quando andai nella città mineraria, mi innamorai. Ma non ebbi il coraggio di rivolgerle la parola, e allora chiesi a un certo ladro famoso di procurarmi questo. Così io e lei siamo sempre insieme. Ebbene, mi invidiate, vero?\" \n# ~Le Ultime Parole di <Luster> il nobile~

jp: \t\tアダマンタイト鉱石の欠片。比較的粗悪な部類なので装飾品にもならず、こうして投擲武器として使うのが関の山である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tアダマンタイト鉱石の欠片。比較的粗悪な部類なので装飾品にもならず、こうして投擲武器として使うのが関の山である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Adamantite ore shards. Since it is relatively crude, it cannot be used as an ornament, and can only be used as a projectile weapon. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Adamantite ore shards. Since it is relatively crude, it cannot be used as an ornament, and can only be used as a projectile weapon. \n#~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una scheggia di minerale d'adamantio. È di qualità piuttosto scadente, quindi non va bene neanche da ornamento, e usarla così come arma da lancio è il massimo che se ne possa fare. \n#~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t投擲用に作られた小型の爆弾。弓なりに着弾した後、大規模な範囲で爆散する為影響は広範囲に与えられるが、同時に敵味方構わず威力を奮うので扱いには注意が必要だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t投擲用に作られた小型の爆弾。弓なりに着弾した後、大規模な範囲で爆散する為影響は広範囲に与えられるが、同時に敵味方構わず威力を奮うので扱いには注意が必要だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Small bombs designed for throwing. After landing in a bow, the bomb explodes in a large area, giving it a wide range of effects, but at the same time, it is powerful regardless of friend or foe, so it must be handled with care. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Small bombs designed for throwing. After landing in a bow, the bomb explodes in a large area, giving it a wide range of effects, but at the same time, it is powerful regardless of friend or foe, so it must be handled with care. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una bomba piccola, fatta per essere lanciata. Cade dopo un arco e scoppia su un'area larga, quindi l'effetto arriva lontano; ma la forza la scarica su amici e nemici allo stesso modo, e va maneggiata con attenzione. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t異国の諜報組織が用いる、刃のある投擲武器。形は千差万別だが、どの武器にも満遍なく止血を遅らせる毒が塗られており、当たった相手に出血を被らせるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の諜報組織が用いる、刃のある投擲武器。形は千差万別だが、どの武器にも満遍なく止血を遅らせる毒が塗られており、当たった相手に出血を被らせるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A bladed throwing weapon used by foreign intelligence organizations. They come in a variety of shapes and sizes, but all are said to be coated with a poison that delays coagulation and causes the target to bleed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A bladed throwing weapon used by foreign intelligence organizations. They come in a variety of shapes and sizes, but all are said to be coated with a poison that delays coagulation and causes the target to bleed. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'arma da lancio con la lama, in uso presso i servizi segreti di un paese straniero. Le forme sono le più varie, ma su tutte è spalmato per bene un veleno che ritarda la chiusura delle ferite, e si dice che faccia sanguinare chi viene colpito. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t銃の名工が作り上げたとされる、光に乱反射する散弾銃。銃口から勢いよく放出される特殊な硝煙は、詠唱を妨げる特殊な力を持つという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t銃の名工が作り上げたとされる、光に乱反射する散弾銃。銃口から勢いよく放出される特殊な硝煙は、詠唱を妨げる特殊な力を持つという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Shotgun that reflects light diffusely, said to have been created by a master gunmaker. The special gunpowder smoke that is vigorously emitted from the muzzle is said to have a special power to interfere with chanting. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Shotgun that reflects light diffusely, said to have been created by a master gunmaker. The special gunpowder smoke that is vigorously emitted from the muzzle is said to have a special power to interfere with chanting. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un fucile a pompa che rimanda la luce in ogni direzione, e che si dice sia opera di un maestro armaiolo. Il fumo di polvere speciale che erompe con forza dalla bocca dell'arma avrebbe il potere singolare di disturbare il lancio degli incantesimi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t未知の素材でできた長弓。身に付けた者に風の加護を与え、一度弓引けばそこに風の女神の姿を見るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t未知の素材でできた長弓。身に付けた者に風の加護を与え、一度弓引けばそこに風の女神の姿を見るという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Longbow made of an unknown material. It is said to give the wearer the blessing of the wind, and once the bow is drawn, the wearer will see the Goddess of Wind. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Longbow made of an unknown material. It is said to give the wearer the blessing of the wind, and once the bow is drawn, the wearer will see the Goddess of Wind. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un arco lungo fatto di un materiale sconosciuto. Dà a chi lo porta addosso la protezione del vento, e si dice che, una volta teso l'arco, là si veda la figura della dea del vento. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t乙女の為に専用の職人が織り上げたという「武器」。何故下着が武器となるのか、それは食らってみれば自ずと理解できるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t乙女の為に専用の職人が織り上げたという「武器」。何故下着が武器となるのか、それは食らってみれば自ずと理解できるだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A 'weapon' woven by a craftsman exclusively for maidens. You will understand why underwear can be used as a weapon when you have a taste of it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A 'weapon' woven by a craftsman exclusively for maidens. You will understand why underwear can be used as a weapon when you have a taste of it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'\"arma\" che a quanto si dice un artigiano apposito tesse per le fanciulle. Perché mai la biancheria sia un'arma, lo si capisce da sé una volta che la si è presa in faccia. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
